meta.name: eol-internal-enablement
meta.description: Build the support FAQ, sales talking points, and objection handling teams need before an EOL announcement. Use when customer-facing teams must be ready before customers hear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提前备好EOL公告前的支持FAQ与销售话术
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们产品即将停售,需要让客服和销售提前做好问答和话术准备。
copy.tagline_en: Prepare support FAQs and sales talking points before EOL announcements.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your product is nearing end-of-life and you need to ready customer-facing teams in advance.

howto.what: 安装后，当产品停用(EOL)临近时，Claude会为客服和销售团队生成内部准备材料，包括支持FAQ、销售话术、异议处理脚本和升级手册，并根据停用范围推荐材料级别和完成日期。
howto.when: 当客服或销售团队必须在客户听到EOL消息前做好准备时触发；用户提供停用产品、替代品、关键日期后启动。

say.text: 帮我为旧版模块停用做内部赋能包，替代品是新看板，年底停用。
只写支持FAQ，小功能下线，没有替代品，三周后通知。
say.note: 只产出FAQ，适合小范围功能下线。

say.text: 我们三周后公布EOL，销售总被问住，给我销售话术和异议处理。
say.note: 生成销售话术与异议处理脚本，不含FAQ。

howto.what_en: Claude builds pre-announcement packs for support/sales: FAQ, talking points, objection handling, escalation ladder; recommends a level and sets completion date before announcement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when customer-facing teams must be ready before customers hear. Starts after user supplies the sunset product, replacement, and key dates, or directly requests the pack.

say_en.text: Build the internal pack for our old module EOL, replaced by dashboard, Dec 31.
say_en.note: Generates the Level 2 pack with FAQ and sales materials.

say_en.text: Support FAQ only, small feature sunset, no replacement, three weeks notice.
say_en.note: Produces just the FAQ for a minor deprecation.

say_en.text: EOL in 3 weeks; sales ambushed. Give talking points and objection handling.
say_en.note: Creates sales talking points and objection scripts, no FAQ.
